preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges
preconditions.description: The weight of each edge must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The start vertex u must be a valid vertex index between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the total weight of the edges of the tree followed by the indices of the edges included in the tree.
The number of edges in the tree must be exactly n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge_index <= m for edge_index in edge_indices)
postconditions.description: All edge indices in the output must be valid indices from the input edges.
